name: Amazon.sg (Amazon Singapore)

scam_info.sample: Only link to sites that begin with "http://"something".amazon.com or amazon.sg". ... May contain links to websites that resemble Amazon but aren't Amazon, such as "payments-amazon.sg".
scam_info.notes: Amazon.sg 'Identifying a Scam' help page (Security and Privacy > Communications from Amazon.sg). Genuine link domains *.amazon.com / *.amazon.sg; example fake domain payments-amazon.sg (fake, text only, never visited); forward suspicious messages to verify@amazon.sg; 'Report a Scam' / unwanted packages at account-status.amazon.sg. Links to sub-pages on fake emails, SMS, calls, websites (not opened). Undated.

notes: official_domains: amazon.sg and amazon.com are (a) on the SG scam help page. nodeId G4YFYCCNUSENA23B is Amazon's standard 'Identifying a Scam' help node (same ID across Amazon marketplaces); not disallowed by amazon.sg robots.txt. Global amazon.com equivalents not recorded.
